projects.title: FNB Lifetime Website
projects.description: I was responsible for creating this website for FNB Lifetime, a bank in Ohio. Using a WordPress custom theme and their old site as a guideline, I was able to develop this site.

projects.title: CSI Financial Calculator
projects.description: At CSI, I was in charge of developing a financial calculator software that will replace the existing 3rd party software in CSI's premier banking teller software NuPoint. Additionally, the calculator will be used in many of the banking websites I helped create at the company. The calculator performs many operations from calculating your monthly payment on a fixed rate mortgage to how much you need to save for college. The calculator was designed to be a WordPress plugin so it fits seamlessly into most websites.
